# Uprevit

> Uprevit is browser-based software for creating, managing, and tracking medical device labeling documentation. Teams collaborate across departments, projects, and products in one workspace.

- Documentation templates follow global standards, including EU MDR, FDA UDI, Health Canada, and ISO 15223-1 symbols.
- Version control, time-stamped change history, and automated redlining against the master version.
- Role-based access control for every user, team, and department.
- Exports to PDF dossiers and Excel (XLSX) workbooks for use in ERP, PLM, and MES systems.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.uprevit.com/): Product overview and FAQ
- [Platform overview](https://www.uprevit.com/platform/overview): Departments, projects, roles, and governance in one workspace
- [Products & bulk import](https://www.uprevit.com/platform/products): Seven structured product tabs, label callouts, and validated Excel import
- [Version control](https://www.uprevit.com/platform/version-control): Draft, submitted, in review, released, and obsolete lifecycle tracking
- [Redlining](https://www.uprevit.com/platform/redlining): Automated field-by-field diffs against the master version
- [Approval workflows](https://www.uprevit.com/platform/approval-workflows): Cross-functional sign-off across regulatory, quality, and packaging teams
- [Reports & exports](https://www.uprevit.com/platform/reports-exports): Portfolio query reports plus full PDF and XLSX product exports
- [Pricing](https://www.uprevit.com/pricing): Platform fee, seat roles, metered usage, and optional add-ons
- [Resources](https://www.uprevit.com/resources): Labeling guides, articles, standards, and templates
- [Blog](https://www.uprevit.com/resources/blogs): Articles on medical device labeling and standards
- [Contact](https://www.uprevit.com/contact): Demos, pricing, and enterprise questions (contact@uprevit.com)
